name: Neem Tulsi Shot
subtitle: the bitterest of the lot, taken in spring

ingredients.note: young leaves only; old ones are unbearable
the tulsi is there to make the neem possible

steps.text: Wash the neem and tulsi leaves well.
Blend with 100ml water until the leaves break down entirely.
Strain twice through muslin. Any leaf fragment left in will make it worse.
Stir in the honey, lemon and pepper. Drink in one go; it does not improve with sipping.

storage: Same day. Neem juice darkens and turns harsher within hours.

provenance.note: Neem is taken in early spring across much of India, when the tender leaves come. In Bengal it appears at the start of a meal as neem begun; in the south it is drunk on Ugadi. It is a bitter tonic, not a refreshment.
